microphone_array.status: four synchronized MEMS channels are a packaging baseline, not a chosen count; verify beamforming, echo cancellation, acoustic shadowing, and target noise field on the actual head

speaker.role: own synthesized tones/voice output; output level and acoustic echo path unselected

calibration_requirements: camera-to-base extrinsics per CAD and measured fixture
microphone channel phase/gain and array geometry
speaker-to-microphone echo path and output mute/feedback policy

validation_scope: OCC solid validity, source mesh bbox, and STEP round-trip are checked. Bbox containment is not surface fit, collision clearance, kinematics or physical validation.
not_verified: The normalized 1350 mm scale remains a working envelope, not source-model evidence or a physical measurement.
The 25 kg mass allocation and center of mass are PLACEHOLDER inputs only; no as-built mass claim is authorized.
All links, actuator envelopes, joint origins and limits require selected-component and load-case review.
Neutral-pose arm anchors are corrected to hang beside the body; full swept self-collision and cable/service-volume checks remain required.
Sensor boxes/frames reserve space only. Camera lenses, intrinsics, acoustic array geometry, speaker and processing hardware are unselected.
No shell panel is a supplier-ready part: material, inserts, tolerances, load cases, fit and structural/thermal behavior are open.
Collision/dynamics MJCF is a simplified model. Validate contact, inertias, actuator torque-speed/thermal limits, and model/backend convergence before transfer claims.
